doc: The harness over MCP, for an agent that has no hooks. Read-only by construction: every tool describes work, and none records, dispatches or verifies. The engine holds the allow-list of tasks and flags, and `noetic-harness validate` refuses this file if a tool steps outside it.

tools.name: harness_route
tools.description: Which workflow a piece of work routes to, which gate lane it will have to pass, and who should do it. Call it before starting non-trivial work.

args.name: title
args.description: What you are about to do, in a sentence.

args.name: body
args.description: More detail, if the title is thin.

args.name: paths
args.description: Files you expect to touch, repository-relative.

tools.name: harness_context
tools.description: What you should read before starting: the specs, ADRs, prior memory and open work relevant to this task.

args.name: title
args.description: What you are about to do, in a sentence.

args.name: body
args.description: More detail, if the title is thin.

args.name: paths
args.description: Files you expect to touch, repository-relative.

tools.name: harness_prompt
tools.description: The contract a specialist role works under: its mandate, trust level, skills and the gates it answers to.

tools.name: harness_workflows
tools.description: The workflows this repository develops itself by, or one workflow's steps in order with the gates each must pass.

args.name: show
args.description: A workflow id such as WF-002. Omit it for the list.

tools.name: harness_gates_plan
tools.description: Which gates a change to these paths will have to pass, resolved without running any of them.

args.name: lane
args.description: fast, focused or full. `harness_route` names the lane.

tools.name: harness_memory
tools.description: What earlier work in this repository learned about a subject: lessons, decisions and their confidence.

args.name: query
args.description: A word or phrase, e.g. release or flaky.

tools.name: harness_environment_brief
tools.description: The brief of one evaluation environment: a task derived from a real commit, as a dispatched agent would be given it.

tools.name: harness_classify
tools.description: Where a failure routes: which failure class the evidence belongs to, and what the harness does about that class.

args.name: evidence
args.description: The failure text: a test failure, an error, a gate's output.
